subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Strategy is very important for an examinee. He take care of what he is allowed to take and not allowed to take in the exam hall. He must go through the question paper thoroughly and budget his time for each question. He should not waste time by writing elaborate answer. He should be particular about his hand writing.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Nawab Faijunnesa Govt. Girls' High School, Comilla. Sl. No. 28; Page No. 77
